name: Porus
description: The story of Indian warrior Porus and his life especially the Battle of the Hydaspes with the Great Alexander.

videos.title: The Epic Story Of A Warrior
videos.overview: Set in 350 BC, Porus is an untold story of the most spirited defender of India. The story traces the time when Porus was born to the time he becomes one of the greatest warriors of the world. He is the first defender of India who fought the greatest

videos.title: Welcome With a Fight
videos.overview: Darius presents glass and actuate Amatya Shiv Dutt to kill the person who disrespected him. Queen Anusuya notices her brother wounded in a fight

videos.title: Anusuya Stays in Poravs
videos.overview: Queen Anusuya is deserted on the sides of Jhelum river and asks Jhelam what she should do now after everything.

videos.title: Olympia Prays For A Child
videos.overview: Philip enters Olympia's room to warn and force her to accept defeat against Macedonia. Olympia prayer Zeus to give her a child and not from Philip's son.

videos.title: The Prediction
videos.overview: Anusuya learns from a seer about the future of her unborn son. The seer informs her that she will give birth to a son, who shall fulfill her dream of united country.

videos.title: Olympias' Quest
videos.overview: Anusuya sees Darius among people and follows him. She almost catches him but he disappears into the crowd.

videos.title: For Honor
videos.overview: Anusuya meets her brother, the Taxila King. She is forced to take revenge for the humiliation that her brother had to face because of Bahmani, who is unaware of the plan brewing between them. What will Anusuya do? Will she obey her brother’s command?

videos.title: Anusuya’s Revenge
videos.overview: Anusuya wants to take revenge from Bamni as she is furious about what he did to her.

videos.title: The Threat
videos.overview: Bamni is carried to safety as Taxila army enters the fort. Anusuya puts a knife on her brother’s throat and orders him to halt his army. When she sees an ailing Bamni, his brother threatens to kill her.

videos.title: The Birth of Two Warriors
videos.overview: Anusuya manages to hide from her attackers and delivers her son. On the other side of the world, Olympias also delivers her child, who will become Alexander. Meanwhile, Anusuya is caught and faces threat not only to her life but also to her child.

videos.title: Rescued in Time
videos.overview: Anusuya sees her newborn child falling off the cliff. She goes into a state of shock believing that her son is dead. She is then pushed off the cliff by Bhamni’s brother

videos.title: Destiny’s Child
videos.overview: Bhamni’s men who are searching for Anusuya’s newborn child, follow a ship and manage to find the child. When Anusuya’s trusted aid puts up a fight, he is attacked.

videos.title: The Rise of Porus
videos.overview: Bahmni gets married to Kadika on the advice of his brother. On the other side of the world, Olympias is teaching Alexander all the things he needs to be a future conqueror. Meanwhile, Porus is growing up and is being trained by the pirates.

videos.title: Saviour Porus
videos.overview: Porus brutally trashes Darius’ Farsi aide and his soldiers and rushes to save slaves. He lifts heavy pole and engraving it in the ship, making a hole in it.

videos.title: Diamond Quest
videos.overview: Dasyu raja asks Sajjan Singh/Ripu Daman to take slaves out of Dasyu Land and kill them.

videos.title: Protector
videos.overview: Sajjan Singh/Ripu Daman takes salves to the grave yard and ties them to a tree. Hasti informs Puru that baba/Sajjan Singh went to drop slaves to Pourav rastra.

videos.title: Decision To Visit Pourav Rastra
videos.overview: Sajjan Singh’s wife tells Hasti that he will not go to Pourav rastra, let Puru go instead. Hasti says he has got a great opportunity.

videos.title: Confidence Building
videos.overview: Alexander warns king Satishia to run away if he wants to save his life. Satishia laughs and says he will be killed easily. Alexander throws knife on the soldier in a split of second and kills him

videos.title: Threatening Punishment
videos.overview: Puru stops Hasti and says he cannot go to Pourav rastra. Hasti warns him not to interfere as he promised already. Puru gets adamant that he will not let him go and holds his hand.

videos.title: Vision To Attack Bharat
videos.overview: Puru with his team reaches river shore. A man hiding behind tree asks to give his identity.

videos.title: Alexander's Punishment Practice
videos.overview: Philips returns from the battlefield and seeing Shah Thesia’s skeleton tied to a horse asks who did this.

videos.title: A Position In The Army
videos.overview: Farsi soldier misbehaves with Anusuya calling her mad and asks to go away. Anusuya insists to give food to her child. He asks where is her child. Spectators laugh at her.

videos.title: Fight In Paurav Rashtra
videos.overview: Puru takes Anusuya to a hotel where Farsi soldiers are enjoying the feast. Soldiers angrily pull swords

videos.title: Kanishk's Insult
videos.overview: Kanishk with soldiers enters the hotel and sees Farsi soldiers on falling on the floor injured. He sees Puru and says they are meeting again.

videos.title: Bamani Want Porus
videos.overview: In Macedonia, Alexander and his friend enjoy liquor and dance and play a liquor throwing game on target.

videos.title: Mothers Request
videos.overview: Chintan Kumar asks Puru to think if he wants to go tomorrow or not, his duty was to get him here, he is leaving now.

videos.title: Escape Day
videos.overview: Moses asks Darius that he is world’s most powerful country Faras’ king, then why he is behind Bharat.

videos.title: Face Off
videos.overview: Puru sees Chintan hanged on the road and a message for the Dasyus. One of the Dasyu tells that everyone will die just like Chintan.

videos.title: Darius’s Intentions
videos.overview: As Puru are about to leave, he is stopped by the guards. Fearing that he will be caught, Puru turns towards the guard.

videos.title: Puru’s Confrontation
videos.overview: Puru and the Dassiu’s find it hard to get out of the highly guarded palace. During the celebrations, Puru gets into a confrontation with Bamni’s son.

videos.title: The Secret Of Porus
videos.overview: Porus is in disguise. He is asked to greet the Persian princess. The princess asks Porus to show his real face. Will Porus be able to keep his secret? Find out.

videos.title: Porus Escapes
videos.overview: Porus escapes the Paurav kingdom. While his mother is on the verge of being executed.

videos.title: Porus Rescues His Mother
videos.overview: Porus is successful in rescuing his mother. On his way out, he demolishes the stage. The King of Persia insults King Bamni for letting Porus escape.

videos.title: Alexander's Campaign
videos.overview: Porus is returning to the land of the Dasyus. While Alexander is planning a great military campaign. However in the kingdom of Paurav, King Bamni refuses to sit on his throne till the Dasyu who humiliated him is caught.

videos.title: Porus Hides His Mother
videos.overview: King Bamni is still reeling from his humiliation. Meanwhile the Dasyus are preparing for war against the Paurav kingdom. But Porus returns and is able to calm them.

videos.title: Ripudaman Confronts Porus
videos.overview: Sajjan Singh talks to Porus.

videos.title: Sumer Is Discovered
videos.overview: Sumer gets in trouble in the Paurav kingdom.

videos.title: Alexander Returns To Macedonia
videos.overview: Alexander returns to Mcedonia after his battle.

videos.title: The Interrogation Of Sumer
videos.overview: King Bamni and King Darius are readying for a battle between their fighters

videos.title: Memories
videos.overview: Porus sees that the hut in which Anusuya was in has caught fire. He rushes to her rescue and successfully accomplishes the task. Then, Anusuya comes face to face with her past. Will she regain her memory? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Sumer Agrees To Call Puru
videos.overview: Anusuya identifies Ripudaman/Sajjan Singh, reminiscing all the incidents happened in the past.

videos.title: Anusuya Back To Pourav Rastra
videos.overview: Puru decides to go to Paurav rastra to find Anusuya’s family and reunite her with them and get back Sumer.

videos.title: Puru Returns To Save Sumer
videos.overview: Puru decides to go to Paurav rastra to find Anusuya’s family and reunite her with them and get back Sumer.

videos.title: Porus At Sea
videos.overview: Porus is taking Anusuya back to the Paurav kingdom.

videos.title: Plan to Kill Alexander
videos.overview: Alexander enters the bath house unaware that someone has poisoned the water with an intent to kill him. But, to the killer’s dismay, Alexander gets out of the bath house alive.

videos.title: Alexander Defeats Aredius
videos.overview: Alexander faces off against Aredius and defeats him.

videos.title: The Prince Enters The Arena
videos.overview: The last Indian champion is defeated.

videos.title: Porus Enters The Arena
videos.overview: Porus puts on a mask and enters the arena.

videos.title: Aredius Is Becoming Weak
videos.overview: Olympias observes Aredius. She makes him weaker and weaker. Alexander too gets suspicious of what Olympias is doing. Meanwhile Porus defeats the final Persian champion and reveals himself.

videos.title: Porus Wins
videos.overview: After winning the fight, Porus reveals himself to the crowd.

videos.title: Shivdutt warns Puru
videos.overview: Shivdutt warns Puru not to forget that he is in Pourav Rastra and if he does not submit Anusuya to him, he will kill Sumer.

videos.title: Shivdutt Tries To kill Anusuya
videos.overview: Shivdutt lets Sumer go in exchange for Anusuya and captures her. He decides to end her life for once and for all.

videos.title: Anusuya’s Memory
videos.overview: Porus enters the highly guarded palace. He faces Bamni’s guards and neutralizes the threat. Meanwhile, Darius comes face to face with Anusuya. Seeing Darius, Anusuya remembers that he is from Persia. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Kanishk Stabs Puru
videos.overview: Puru warns Shivdutt to return Anusya and pulls a sword on him.

videos.title: Phillip's Legal Heir
videos.overview: Sumer returns back to Dasyu lok and Lachi is angry that he left Puru behind who went to Pourav Rastra to save him.

videos.title: Zeus’ son
videos.overview: Olympias tells Alexander that Philip came to know about him being Zeus’ son and not his, so he will not make him the king.

videos.title: Barsin Misleads Puru
videos.overview: Puru finds Anusuya’s locket and asks Barsin if she can take him to that woman and Barsin agrees.

videos.title: Anusuya is Captured
videos.overview: Anusuya nearly comes face to face with Bamni. A few men barge inside and take Anusuya hostage. Bamni is not able to see Anusuya but she catches a glimpse of him and remembers a few brief moments she spent with him. Will Anusuya regain her memory?

videos.title: Barsin’s Intentions
videos.overview: Olympia tells Alexander he should win the crown at any cost. Alexander takes an oath. Puru defeats Barsin again.

videos.title: Puru Is Devastated
videos.overview: Puru with Barsin reaches the prison and sees soldiers carrying Anusuya’s body and is shattered to see her lying still. Puru determines to kill Bamni and Shivdutt.

videos.title: Puru’s Challenges Bamni
videos.overview: Puru takes Laachi to river shore and asks her to return back to Dasyu Lok. Puru walks away taking an oath to kill Bamni

videos.title: Bamni And Puru’s Fight
videos.overview: Puru walks into the Maha Shivratri celebration and alleges that Bamni is a monster king who killed his wife Anusuya.

videos.title: The Truth Unveiled
videos.overview: Porus engages in a duel with Bamni. Meanwhile, a few men attack Anusuya, who is saved by Ripudaman. Anusuya learns that Puru is her son. Darius learns of Anusuya’s presence when she arrives in the nick of time to stop Puru from harming Bamni.

videos.title: Puru’s Identity
videos.overview: Anusuya arrives when Puru defeats Bamni in the combat. When Puru is about to slay Bamni, Anusuya reveals that he is Bamni’s son. Bamni is overjoyed to meet Anusuya and Puru after many years.

videos.title: Ripudaman’s Last Words
videos.overview: Bamni unleashes the sword to kill his brother but is stopped by Anusuya who does not want blood to be spilled. As Puru is about to hug his father, Bamni, he learns that Ripudaman has been badly injured.

videos.title: Alexander's Journey
videos.overview: Olympias takes Alexander to meet a lady to get answers to his questions. Puru is devastated after Ripudaman's death and blames Bamni for everything.

videos.title: Anusuya Confronts Darius
videos.overview: Alexander learns from the lady that in future he is going to be a great conqueror and to become a great conqueror he has to start from Bharath in the west.

videos.title: Hasti’s Conspiracy
videos.overview: Puru leaves Pourav Rastra with Anusuya to take Ripudaman's body to Dasyu Lok. Bamni is not happy to see them leave. Cleopatra gives birth to a girl child and Phillip is furious.

videos.title: Seeds of Treason
videos.overview: Porus lights Ripudaman’s funeral pyre. While his loyalty is being questioned, Dassiu are unaware that their homes are under attack. Meanwhile, Darius meets Shivdutt and plants the seed of treason. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Dasyu Burns
videos.overview: While people question Puru's loyalty, Faarsi soldiers enter Dasyu Lok and burn it to the ground. Hell broke loose and everyone is running for their lives.

videos.title: Puru Confronts Darius
videos.overview: After the attack on Dasyu Lok, Puru tortures the Faarsi infiltrator that he captured during the attack to get the truth out of him. Anusuya tries to adjust again in Pourav Rastra as a Queen. Dasyu Raaj who was supposed to be dead, survives.

videos.title: Puru's Masterplan
videos.overview: Puru tells Bamni that they should punish the one who is guiding Faroos and that is none other than Faroos King Darius. Puru makes Darius apologise to Anusuya for the inconvenience his battle commander created in Dasyu Lok.

videos.title: Signs Of War
videos.overview: Anusuya is worried about if Puru has taken the right decision to rebel against Darius. Puru manipulates Darius to make him share his plans and then challenges him that he will kick the Faarsi soldiers out of Bharath.

videos.title: The Prince Who Was Promised
videos.overview: Bamni introduces Puru as Pourav rastra’s prince. Alexander tells Olympia that Philip is going to attack Farus and it is the perfect time to play with his mind. Darius decides to wind up all his wealth and send it back to Farus.

videos.title: The First Step
videos.overview: Puru after becoming the Prince, addresses the common people. Puru tells Darius that he wants to see his Farsi market so Darius sends Barsin to give him a tour of the market.

videos.title: Darius Is Furious
videos.overview: Darius is furious as he believes that Puru had something to do with the fire in Faarsi market.

videos.title: Bamni Confronts Puru
videos.overview: After Puru takes his revenge on Darius by setting the Faarsi market on fire, Bamni confronts him about the fire and asks him if he had anything to do with it.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Dassiu believe that Puru has betrayed them and seek revenge. They plan an attack with an intent to destroy the food reserves. Meanwhile, going against the tradition, Puru wants his mother to have supper with him and his father.

videos.title: Puru Brainwashes Barsin
videos.overview: Thatus tries to provoke Phillips' body guard to fight him. Puru tells Anusuya that he'll never accept Bamni as his father. Hasti's actions make Laachi a bit confused and worried.

videos.title: Hasti's Plan
videos.overview: Hasti has sided with Darius out of his hatred for Puru and has decided to kill Puru and King Bamni on Holi. Lachi and other Dasyus don't have any idea about it.

videos.title: Plan to Kill Porus
videos.overview: The assassins sneak into the palace and try to kill Puru. Laachi is informed by her mother that Puru should not find out about their plan. Meanwhile, Olympias is planning to kill Philip. Will her plan be successful? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: The Assassination Attempt
videos.overview: In search of answers, Puru arrives at a desolated spot, unaware that he is being watched by Laachi. Meanwhile, the assassination attempt on Philip fails.

videos.title: The Hideout
videos.overview: Puru finds out the Faarsi hideout and is shocked to see so much gold there. Darius is still raged and wants to take revenge on Puru for the fire in Faarsi market.

videos.title: Puru's Plan
videos.overview: Puru and Laachi fight off the Faarsi soldiers and play a game of "who kills more?" to decide who is a better fighter. Barsin confronts Darius as to why he would fix her marriage with a Bharati and that too Bamni's son Kanishk.

videos.title: Philip’s Assassin
videos.overview: Philip while unveiling his statue reveals his intention to attack Persia. The assassin sent by Olympia is about to kill Philip.

videos.title: Hasti's Lies
videos.overview: Puru spots Hasti in the Holi celebration and tries to find him in the crowd. Posenius attacks Phillips and stabs him in the stomach which makes Phillip collapse.

videos.title: Puru Is Surrounded
videos.overview: King Phillips is dead and Alexander being his son, completes his last rites. Laachi tries to convince her mother that Puru and King Bamni are innocent and had nothing to do with the destruction of Dasyu Lok.

videos.title: Hasti Attacks Kanishk
videos.overview: Holi celebrations are going on in Pourav Rastra and Anusuya gets worried as Puru is nowhere to be seen. Darius's men get Kanishk extremely drunk and let Hasti in his room.

videos.title: Darius’ Revenge
videos.overview: Bamni is informed that Dassiu have made away with the valuables stolen from the treasury. Then, Bamni sees an unconscious body of his son, Kanishl, being carried by Puru to his chamber.

videos.title: Puru Takes The Blame
videos.overview: Puru takes the blame for the attack on Kanishk to save Hasti. Darius's plans work perfectly as Kanishk also blames Puru for the attack as he saw Puru standing behind him right after he was stabbed in the back.

videos.title: Darius Reveals His Plans
videos.overview: Puru recieves 50 lashes in captivity and is not allowed to sleep or eat anything. Darius visits Puru in the cell and calls his a traitor multiple times and evokes anger in Puru with his works. Watch the episode to find what Darius said.to Puru which made his regain his resolve.

videos.title: The Merciless Juggernaught
videos.overview: Alexander's almighty assault leaves nothing standing in his path. The King who dared to oppose him kneels in front of him, as he realized that Alexander and his army are a force not to be reconed with. Meanwhile, Puru is suffering in the prison due to Darius's heinous plan.

videos.title: Traitor's Blood
videos.overview: Olympia stops Alexander from going to India. Alexander doesn't listen to her and Olympia warns Alexander that if he goes to India, he may never come back. Bamni accuses Puru for stabbing Kanishk and looting the Pourav and Faarsi ships and declares Puru a traitor and orders his execution.

videos.title: The Day Arrives
videos.overview: Puru is sentenced to death by King Bamni after he is found guilty of attacking Kanishk and then looting the Pourav and Faarsi ships.

videos.title: Chase
videos.overview: Puru, Lachi and Maharani Anusuya run away from Pourav Rastra after Puru refuses to serve the sentence. King Bamni and Darius send their forces to search for them and bring them back to Pourav Rastra.

videos.title: Takshashila
videos.overview: Maharani Anusuya challenges Darius that if he thinks that she was involved in Puru's escape, he should prove it rather than making accusations.

videos.title: Puru’s Fight
videos.overview: Puru fights a caged bear and ends up slaying the animal. Meanwhile, Anusuya fears for Puru. Bamni forgives Hasti much to Anusuya’s relief. Now that Puru has emerged victorious in the battle, what challenges await him, watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Alexander's Plan
videos.overview: In Macedonia, Alexander's plan to invade Bharath is almost set in motion after Alexander gets a world map and mark his targets. As told by the Oracle, Alexander is to confront Bharath's protector and Alexander is eager to meet him

videos.title: The Conquest Begins
videos.overview: Darius orders his soldiers that the night if Kanishk and Barsin's wedding should be the last night of Pourav's royal family and that they should kill them all.

videos.title: A Request
videos.overview: After Puru saves Ambhi Raj's life, he is impressed. In return Puru requests him to return the favor by providing him his army support to help him build the bridge.

videos.title: Puru is Injured
videos.overview: Anusuya is worried as Darius is nowhere to be seen. Darius is in a confrontation with Puru, who is helpless as Laachi’s life is under threat. Darius attacks Puru, who is injured.

videos.title: The War
videos.overview: The forces of Taxila attack Pauravrastra and Bamni and his forces are caught off-guard. Laachi helps Puru regain consciousness. Bamni finally learns that Darius is behind the attack.

videos.title: The Truth Is Out
videos.overview: Darius's truth is out in front of everyone and Bamni regrets his decision of not trusting Anusuya and Puru. Darius tells Bamni that he killed Puru with his own hands.

videos.title: The Fight Continues
videos.overview: After Maharaj Ambhi turns against Puru and Anusuya, an epic battle takes place between the Pourav Rastra forces and Faarsi & Takshashila alliance.

videos.title: Face the Defeat
videos.overview: The battle continues and Puru is devastated to see the Takshashila Naresh and Maharaj Bamni fighting each other instead of banding together and fighting against Darius.

videos.title: The Battle
videos.overview: Darius reveals his true face and threatens Puru that he will wipe out the entire kingdom. Puru, not the one to back out, puts up a fight. The armies of Darius battle the forces of Pauravrashtra.

videos.title: Atelus' War Gear
videos.overview: Pourav Rastra's forces emerge as the winner of the battle against the Faarsi forces. King Bamni announces Puru as his successor. Alexander reaches Faaras to take Atelus' war gear.

videos.title: Shivdutt's Plan
videos.overview: Alexander takes a step towards conquering Faaras. Darius comes to know about the threat and informs his soldiers to buckle up as they need to teach a lesson of war to the children that are Puru and Alexander.

videos.title: Puru’s Destiny
videos.overview: Puru expresses his undying love to Laachi. Later, Bamni names Puru as the Prince and asks him to take his vows. The priest informs Puru that his destinty is tied to a man who will soon march towards their homeland with his army.

videos.title: Puru Learns About Alexander
videos.overview: Alexander wins a major war. When Alexander’s commander is about to slay the remaining enemy forces, Alexander stops him. Alexander allows the remaining enemy forces to become a part of his army.

videos.title: Puru's Request
videos.overview: After learning about Alexander attacking Faaras, Puru asks King Bamni to let him go to Faaras and take a measure of Alexander and his army and strategize to defend Bharath against him but King Bamni rejects his proposition to leave Pourav Rastra.

videos.title: Alexander's Plan
videos.overview: Alexander meets Darius's sister and tries to persuade her to help him go up against Darius by offering her the Faarsi throne. Kin Bamni announces that Prince Puru will go to Faaras to collect information about Alexander but he will not go alone.

videos.title: The Gordian lock
videos.overview: Puru receives a letter from Barsin saying that Alexander has already won two battles in Faaras and in the next battle Darius plans to face him himself. Puru decides to help Barsin and get her out of Faaras

videos.title: Declare The War
videos.overview: Alexander decides to solve the Gordin's lock and sends Ephastian to give it a try but he fails. Alexander then uses his brain and cut the rope with his sword.

videos.title: Vishkanya
videos.overview: As it turns out, the woman that Puru saved in Faaras and took her on his ship is actually a vishkanya given the task of killing Puru by one of his many enemies. Darius believes that letting Barsin be free was the reason for his loss

videos.title: Plan Your Moves
videos.overview: Vishkanya sends two snakes into Puru's room. Darius plans his next move by sending a dozen infiltrators in Alexander's army who kill dozens of Alexander's men. Alexander decides to take his revenge.

videos.title: Marching Into The Battle
videos.overview: Puru tries to get familiar with the kid that he rescued from Faaras in order to gain his trust and get the truth about Vishkanya out of him.

videos.title: Alexander Battles Darius
videos.overview: Porus manages to escape before the ship sinks into the depths of the ocean. Vishkanya's plan to kill Porus fails. Meanwhile, Alexander prepares for battle against Darius.

videos.title: Ruins Of War
videos.overview: Puru, Laachi, Ambhi, and Hasti save Vishkanya and Moloy from the ship and all of them get stranded on an island. Puru unmasks Vishkanya and tells everyone her truth.

videos.title: Set In Stones
videos.overview: Barsi suggests to his father Darius to settle his disputes with Alexander, as she fears her powers are far more than what they envisions. Hasti holds a sword to Vishkanya’s throat as they fight over their differences.

videos.title: Face To Face
videos.overview: Puru saves Vishkanya from getting killed by the Macedonian soldiers. Alexander conquers Faaras but spares Barsin, her mother and her sister as his fight was with Darius and not with them.

videos.title: Instigated
videos.overview: Alexander addresses the people of Faaras and tells them that they are a part of Macedonia now and he'll make sure that they see better days under his rule. Puru is instigated by Alexander after he takes Barsin, her mother and, her sister

videos.title: The Mystery Unfolds
videos.overview: Ambhiraj is presented with a ring in the royal court, he identifies it as Ambhi Kumar’s. Barsine consoles her fellow queens and talks about faith and hope, to their despair Alexander ruins their hope for anything new.

videos.title: Plans For The Great Escape
videos.overview: Alexander and Ephastian are awaiting for Darius’s reply, while they enjoy the celebration at the royal court. Barsine comes face to face with Porus. They get a message by Ambi Kumar. Alexander threats Barsine not to escape the royal palace.

videos.title: Alexander’s Target
videos.overview: Porus and Lachi are convinced that Alexander is solely trying to find and lock Darius down. Porus consoles Lachi that Alexander will not let any harm come upon Barsine and her family. Kanish is furious that Puru will take over the throne.

videos.title: Alexander’s Sick Demand
videos.overview: Alexander is making everyone in his kingdom kiss his feet as a sign of showing respect. Porus and Lachi is in the midst of the crowd and Porus plans to rebel. Ephesian spots Porus and a fight breaks in.

videos.title: Locked Up
videos.overview: Porus is taken as a prisoner by Alexander. Ephastian taunts Porus about his status resulting Porus to get furious with Ephastian and Alexander. Kanishk and Shivdutt drink to Porus being in prison. Porus is dragged for a Gladiator fight.

videos.title: Gladiator
videos.overview: Porus tied in chains is brought to the arena. He faces one of the strongest gladiator of the empire. He fights and wins but finally lends a helping hand to his enemy. Alexander watch as Porus wins. Lachi makes a new plan. Watch the full episode!

videos.title: Arrows To The Chest
videos.overview: The Gladiator fight continues as Porus defeats the first set of Alexander’s soldiers. Ephastian announces that the fight will go on. Porus wins again with the enemy down to their knees.

videos.title: One Man Army
videos.overview: Porus regains his strength and gets up. The arrows can’t kill Porus. He defeats the Alexander’s army and holds a sword to his neck. The whole empire is shocked to see Porus’s power. Watch to find out!

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Porus holds a sword to Alexander’s throat and threats hin for his life. He makes a butf escape but Hephaestion follows him throughout on horseback. Anusuya confides in Bamni that Shivdutt was trying to kill her and Malay. Bamni gets furious.

videos.title: Dethrone
videos.overview: Porus has escaped Alexande’s empire and now Alexander and his soldiers are on the look out. Porus’s father is being dethroned, its a shame for him to bear. Alexander captures Lachi. Watch what happens next!

videos.title: On The Run
videos.overview: Porus has escaped Alexander’s rule. He is on horseback and riding his way back to home, but what he doesn’t know is at home, his father is dethroned and put in prison.

videos.title: Tortured
videos.overview: Bamni and his wife is in captive and being tortured. Porus is not there to fight for his parents. He and Lachi are on a boat across the ocean. Alexander mistreats Barsine. Watch how the story unfolds.

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: Kadika pleads to Kanishk not to lose himself in sake of gaining more power. In Bactria, Alexander with Hephastian and Olympa is greeted by Bessus. But Alexander kills Bessus in the most shocking way possible.

videos.title: A Mother's Request
videos.overview: Anusuya requests Kanishk to reconsider his decision but before Kanishk can give it a thought, Shivdutt intervenes. Porus arrives just as a sword is about to take the life of Bamni and Anusuya.

videos.title: The Tables are Turned
videos.overview: Porus turns the tables around and defeats Kanishk. But, Shiv Dutt deceives Anusuya and captures her. While capturing Anusuya, Shiv Dutt stabs Bamni, leaving him severely injured.

videos.title: Wounded Father
videos.overview: Porus carries his wounded bleeding father on horse back. He tries to keep his father conscious as they go travel to a safe zone. On the other side, Kanishk is threatening Porus’s mother and has held a sword by her throat.

videos.title: Sense Of Responsibility
videos.overview: Puru gets to know about the threat when he is informed about Alexander reaching Bharath so he decides to stop Alexander on his way rather than going after Shivdutt and Kanishk to save Anusuya.

videos.title: Time Is Running Out
videos.overview: Porus gets involved in the strategies of how to stop Alexander from infiltrating his kingdom. Poru’s mother is being held accountable for all the misfortune.

videos.title: Taint The Honor
videos.overview: Puru makes strategies to stop Alexander's forces and defeat him on the battlefield and on the other side, Anusuya is being tortured continuously by Shivdutt in front of the people of Pourav Rastra.

videos.title: Prepare For The Worst
videos.overview: Anusuya assures the Pourav Rastra's people captured by Shivdutt that they will take their revenge on him soon. Acharya Vishnugupt talks to Alexander and teaches him lessons of the Indian ways.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Puru prepares for the great war to come and gives Laachi a secret errand to run for him. Acharya Vishnugupta takes his leave from Alexander and wishes him good fortune in the wars to come.

videos.title: On The Battlefield
videos.overview: Puru with the Takshashila forces reach the battlefield and witness Alexander coming towards them with a large armada. But when Alexander reaches the field, he is greeted by a group of rage-filled elephants.

videos.title: Puru's Courage
videos.overview: Puru's plan with the elephants work and he is successful in destroying almost half of Alexander's armada but somehow Alexander is able to get back on his feet and take control of the situation. Ambhi Kumar urges his father to fight for Puru

videos.title: Alexander Vs. Porus
videos.overview: It ‘s time that Porus and Alexander come face to face, the war is on. As thousands of soldiers try to fight Porus, he somehow survives it all. Finally in a hand to hand battle, Porus falls into the ocean.

videos.title: The Betrayal Of Takshashila
videos.overview: Puru after faking his death comes back and is greeted by Bamni. Acharya Vishnugupt also reaches there and discusses the further plan with Puru. He also states that he was disheartened after Takshashila's betrayal.

videos.title: Acharya's Words Of Wisdom
videos.overview: Puru takes the blessings of Jhelum and promises that he won't let a foreign invader rule his golden bird Bharath. The news of Puru's demise reaches Anusuya in Pourav Rastra but she still believes that Puru will return to save her.

videos.title: Return Of A King
videos.overview: Puru returns to Pourav Rastra disguised as an old man with Laachi and plans on ending Shivdutt's reign and save Anusuya once and for all. Alexander's wife makes him realize that Porus might not have actually died while crossing the bridge.

videos.title: Optimistic Approach
videos.overview: Porus and Lachi disguise themselves to enter enemy territory. Shivdutt gets furious once he gets to know about Porus infiltrating in his empire. Alexander is convinced that Porus is still alive.

videos.title: Price Of Freedom
videos.overview: Puru is raged after seeing Shivdutt and wants to kill him right then but Acharya Vishnugupt stops him and says that the time will come. Maharaj Bamni comes back to Pourav Rastra and bands with his soldiers secretly.

videos.title: The Real Fight
videos.overview: Maharaj Bamni comes face to face with Shivdutt and engages in a combat with him. Alexander finds the dead body of a man in the river which Puru planted himself with his own ring on it to make Alexander believe that it was his.

videos.title: Trial And Execution
videos.overview: Puru comes face to face with Shivdutt and holds his trial with everyone in sight as judges. He makes Maharani Anusuya execute him in front of everyone and burns him alive.

videos.title: Kanishk's Trial
videos.overview: Kanishk find Shivdutt's dead body and is filled with rage and decides to get his revenge on Puru. Alexander's mother decides to return to Macedonia now that the biggest threat to her son is no more.

videos.title: The Game Begins
videos.overview: Alexander in his fury takes over all of his ministers and declares that he will be killing Porus once and for all. Porus and Lachi spend some quality time together.

videos.title: The Decision Is Yours
videos.overview: Acharya Vishnugupt welcomes Alexander to Pourav Rastra and escorts him into the Raaj Mahal where he believes that he is to be announced as the king but gets shocked after seeing Puru alive. Now Puru has a decision to make whether kill Alexander

videos.title: Alexander Lives
videos.overview: As Porus gets the choice to either kill Alexander or to let him go, he chooses to let him live. As the whole kingdom watches, Porus claims that the kingdom will follow the king, so he resents the bloodshed.

videos.title: The Coronation
videos.overview: Puru's coronation takes place in Pourav Rastra after he has let Alexander leave alive. Acharya Vishnugupt believes that his decision to let Alexander leave was wrong.

videos.title: Chanakya's Decision
videos.overview: Alexander is eager to take revenge on Porus and Olympia wants to exact revenge on Chanakya for betraying her. Meanwhile, Anusuya informs Laachi that she will be the Queen soon and warns her of the turmoil the impending war will bring on the nation.

videos.title: Crossing the River
videos.overview: Chanakya announces that Porus will lose the war as he isn't prepared to defend his kingdom against Alexander. Porus shows Chanakya that his army is ready for battle.

videos.title: Love And War
videos.overview: As Porus and Lachi are elated about their engagement ceremony, they take each other for life. The royal court joins as Lachi and Porus takes the next step. Outside in the kingdom Alexander has attacked and everything burns in the fire of his rage.

videos.title: The Message
videos.overview: Porus and Lachi celebrate their engagement and all the members of the royal court give them their blessing. Alexander gets a message with dead bodies of his soldiers warning him about his presence.

videos.title: Wrath
videos.overview: As Barsine is locked up by Alexander she wishes that Porus come to rescue her. Porus and Lachi’s engagement celebration is going on, and the empire seems to be elated.

videos.title: The Engagement
videos.overview: As Porus and Lachi hold hands for ever, its time to set free all inhibitions and enjoy this glorious mood. But Alexander is agitated and targeting to put Porus down.

videos.title: The Plot to Assassinate Porus
videos.overview: Porus is stung by a scorpion and the venom starts spreading throughout his body. The antivenom given by Chanakya proves handy as Porus takes it in the nick of time. It is suspected that Parsin hatched the plot to kill Porus.

videos.title: Conflict
videos.overview: Porus finds out that his murder was plotted by none other than Barsine. Acharya Chanakya gets captured by Alexander and on his death row. More and more problems rise up, as there is a spy in Puru’s empire.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: Alexander has captured Acharya Chanakya, and he claims that killing Acharya will set an example of Alexander’s power in front of all the kings and kingdoms. Porus’s doubt solidify about Kanishk, that he might be the one who had set the trap.

videos.title: The Assassin
videos.overview: While in confinement, Chanakya refuses to bow down to Alexander, who reveals to Chanakya that Porus will soon breathe his last. Meanwhile, the assassin sneaks into the palace with the help of Laachi's brother.

videos.title: Kanishk’s Master Plan
videos.overview: It’s Porus and Lachi’s wedding day and everyone in the kingdom is more than happy to join the celebration. In between the event, Kanishk plans his attack on Porus, and Sumer helps him through with it.

videos.title: Laachi Defends Porus
videos.overview: Laachi stands against her mother and defends Porus' honor in front of Dassiu. The Dassiu are enraged that Laachi, who is one of their own, is now defending Porus

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: The night before the trial, Laachi advises Porus to be a just king. Anusuya meets Porus and informs him that the death of Laachi's brother could have been avoided. Meanwhile, Chanakya prepares himself before Alexander sentences him to death.

videos.title: The Judgement
videos.overview: It’s time for the trial at the royal court. Lachi and Poru’s mother deliver their statements about the death of Laachi’s brother. Poru’s mother explains the reason for her erratic behavior.

videos.title: Who Will Porus Choose?
videos.overview: It’s time to take the final decision, and Porus has to punish the guilty. One one side it’s his wife Laachi’s family on the other it’s his own, what will Porus choose? Laachi’s sword swing at King Naresh makes Porus bleed.

videos.title: Seven Days
videos.overview: After the grand trial Porus takes the decision that his mother is innocent, but his decision is influenced by Laachi. Laachi commands that Queen Anusuya will get seven days to prove why and how, Sumer was guilty.

videos.title: The Captive
videos.overview: An argument between Alexander and Kanishk leads to a battle for life between the two. Kanishk manages to escape and Alexander follows him. Meanwhile, Chanakya and disciples capture Olympias and produce her before Anusuya.

videos.title: Kanishk Is No More
videos.overview: Alexander runs behinds Kanish, and Porus follows both of them. Finally Alexander finds Kanishk and kills him on the spot. Back at Porus’s Empire, Anusuya and Olympias argue about their ideologies of war and life.

videos.title: A New Advancement
videos.overview: Porus and his father find Kanishk. Kanish is bleeding to his death, and in his last breath, he tells Porus that he had framed Porus’s murder at the wedding event, and Sumer was involved in it.

videos.title: Unstable Circumstances
videos.overview: Acharya returns to Paurav Empire to claim that Sumer was involved with Kanish, in the plotting of Porus’s murder. Laachi parents get furious over their son’s death and decide to leave Paurav Rashtra and take Laahi with them.

videos.title: Breaking All Ties
videos.overview: Chanakya reveals to Porus that Olympias has been taken captive. But, Porus is reluctant to use Olympias to gain an advantage in the war.

videos.title: Burning The Bridges
videos.overview: Alexander and Cleitus discuss their failure in building a bridge over river Jhelum that can carry Alexander’s army, he learns that the Dasyus Clan live in water and they are quite efficient in the skill of building bridges.

videos.title: The Conspiracy
videos.overview: Queen Olympias captive at Paurav Rashtra, is setting up a black-magic chamber, Porus and Laachi intervene her ritual to get negative replies from her. Alexander is setting up his army to attack Paurav Rashtra to rescue Olympias.

videos.title: The Battle Begins
videos.overview: Porus decides to use the skills he learned from Dassiu in the war against Alexander. Meanwhile, the Dassiu are helping Alexander's army in their attempts to cross the river.

videos.title: The War Is On
videos.overview: Porus and his father prepares for the war and charges forward. While Anusuya and Laachi give them their blessing, Olympias is still captive, but she is setting up her black-magic ritual to cast a dark cloud over Porus.

videos.title: Olympias’s Black-Magic
videos.overview: As the war takes a more violent form, everyone is distorted in what to do next. Porus charges in and comes face to face with Barsine. Meanwhile Olympias’s black magic ritual is getting a score, and obstacles are piling up in front of Porus.

videos.title: A New Strategy
videos.overview: Hasthi escapes before Alexander can kill him. Porus returns to the palace to a rousing welcome and is hailed by Anusuya. Accompanying Porus is Parsin, who is asked by Porus to stay in the palace for 15 days.

videos.title: The Dark Arts
videos.overview: Porus has returned from the battle after defeating Alexander. Laachi assures Porus that he is safe and sound in his own palace. Olympias continues to complete her black-magic rituals, and Porus’s health deteriorates.

videos.title: The Secret Message
videos.overview: Porus gets a message from Ambi Kumar, that Alexander is trying something across the river. Olympias casts a black-magic spell on Anusuya and she is under Olympia’s control now.

videos.title: The Ultimatum
videos.overview: Porus and Laachi stumble upon the Dassiu forces who are trying to build a bridge that will help the Alexander army to cross the river.

videos.title: Time To Avenge
videos.overview: Alexander gets a message that Barsine has escaped, he gets enraged with fury and has no time to lose. Alexander discusses with Hephaestion that their army must take full control and charge the Paurav Empire.

videos.title: Under The Influence
videos.overview: Before going to war Queen Anusuya challenges Porus for a sword duel. Porus gets ready but what he doesn’t know is that Anusuya is under the control of Olympia’s dark-magic. Anusuya violently injures Porus.

videos.title: The Sacred Ritual
videos.overview: Porus and Acharya Chanakya find out the Olympias has dark-magic powers seated deep within her. They prepare for a ritual to cleanse her soul and bring her back to consciousness. Alexander finds out that his mother is being held captive.

videos.title: Alexander Plans His Revenge
videos.overview: After the reading the message Alexander is filled with pain and agony that his mother has been captured by his nemesis. Anusuya comes back to her senses and asks for forgiveness. Alexander plans his next step to defeat Porus.

videos.title: Fight For The Motherland
videos.overview: Dasyu Raj and Maha Nandini decide that helping Alexander would create anarchy and put Laachi’s life in danger, so they take back their helping hands but Hephaestion very cleverly stabs Maha Nandini to her death

videos.title: The Dawn of War
videos.overview: The war has dawned upon the land and the battlefield awaits the arrival of Porus and Alexander's army. To reach the battlefield, Alexander's army has to cross the river. Awaiting their arrival on the other side of the river is Porus and his army.

videos.title: Porus Has The Upper Hand
videos.overview: As the war has come to a mid-ground, the news spread that Porus has defeated most of Alexander’s army, and is finally moving forward to rescue Dasyu Raj. On reaching he learns that Laachi’s mother has been killed by Alexander.

videos.title: Alexander's Strategy
videos.overview: Olympias regains consciousness and informs Anusuya that Alexander can't be killed and he has already infiltrated their land.

videos.title: The Time Has Come
videos.overview: Dasyu Raj and Porus devise a new plan of attacking Alexander’s army from underwater, and their plan gets executed successfully. Alexander takes full charge and starts attacking the Paurav empire. Olympias laments her decisions.

videos.title: The War Has Just Started
videos.overview: Porus finds his brother at the aftermath of the war. Alexander has retreated his army and has decided to attack when they least expect it. Ambi Raj is heading Towards Paurav Empire and Laachi and Anusuya is getting ready with their swords.

videos.title: The Face-Off
videos.overview: The battlefield witnesses intense fight between Alexander and Bamni, who seeks revenge on Alexander for the death of his son. Meanwhile, Laachi and Anusuya stop the forces of Ambhiraj from proceeding.

videos.title: The War Begins
videos.overview: Porus battles Alexander and his army to the tune of the thousands. Assisting Porus are his mother and wife. Anusuya puts up a tough fight to defeat not only the forces of Alexander but also the army of her brother.

videos.title: Anusuya Against Ambi-Raj
videos.overview: As the war takes an ugly turn, Laachi and Anusuya are left alone. Porus kills Alexander’s horse leaving him in tears. Back at Paurav Empire Anusuya is left alone against Ambi-Raj and his numerous armies.

videos.title: Anusuya’s Last Fight
videos.overview: As the war reaches its peak, Ambi-Raj captures Anusuya, in the midst of the raging war, Anusuya is left alone and wounded. Ambi-Raj forgets his empathy and stabs Anusuya.

videos.title: In His Arms
videos.overview: Anusuya falls injured, Porus and his father arrive but it’s too late. They take her to the medic. Laachi shares her insecurities with Porus and finally Porus picks up his dagger and plans to avenge his mother’s death.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Porus seeks revenge on Ambhiraj and decides to strike a deal with Alexander. In return for Olympias, Porus asks Alexander to hand over Ambhiraj.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Alexander has set up a trap for Porus. By agreeing to hand over Ambhiraj, Alexander wants to trap the rival forces. But, Porus finds out about the plan and retaliates. Ambhiraj makes an attempt to escape but Porus doesn't allow that to happen.

videos.title: Her Last Words
videos.overview: Anusuya is in her death bed, and Porus’s whole world has come crashing on him. Where Alexander is rejoicing with his mother, Porus is lamenting his mother’s death.

videos.title: The Last Rites
videos.overview: Porus performs the last rites of his mother, Anusuya. After the ashes are submerged at sea, Porus receives a message from Abhiraj, who wants to schedule a meeting with Porus. What is Ambhiraj's plan?

videos.title: The Double-Cross
videos.overview: Ambi Raj plays a trick on Porus trying to bring him closer to Alexander, but things turn nasty as Alexander and Ambi Raj doesn’t know that fact that Porus is already aware of what Ambi has done.

videos.title: Ambi-Raj Is No More
videos.overview: orus and his father, find and trap Ambi-Raj, and serve him the punishment that he deserved. Ambi-Raj tries to escape and ask forgiveness, but for someone who has killed his own sister, there is no mercy.

videos.title: Barsine Fights Back
videos.overview: After Ambi-Raj’s death, Alexander has taken full charge against Porus. Barsine has taken an oath to protect and fight with Porus, and she doesn’t move from her words.

videos.title: The Grand Plan
videos.overview: After Ambi-Raj’s death, his sons switches sides and claims that he will take revenge and see Porus’s end. On the other side, Barsine faces a new set of difficulties while joining arms with Porus.

videos.title: Loyalties Change
videos.overview: Ambi has swiftly tricked Alexander into thinking he is on Alexander’s side, but actually, he is working towards achieving his master plan with Porus. When nothing goes accordingly Alexander thinks of how to put Porus down to his knees.

videos.title: Alexander's Gift
videos.overview: A new epidemic is spreading and Porus army is falling victim. Unaware to Porus, Alexander has breached the walls without ever having to cross the river.

videos.title: The Solution
videos.overview: Porus takes a tough decision in order to save the people from the epidemic and orders his men to destroy all the food stored for the future. The decision comes at a cost; the people face starvation.

videos.title: Commoners Before The Royals
videos.overview: Porus’s decision has saved the people of Paurav Empire, but there are signs of starvation coming along the way. Porus takes another decision to give away the stored food for the royals to the common people of the empire.

videos.title: Barsine Changes The Game
videos.overview: Porus and his empire are coming to a bad ending, there is a scarcity of food and people are dying out of disease and hunger. Meanwhile, Barsine is trying her best to plant the seed of mistrust in Alexander’s army.

videos.title: The People's King
videos.overview: Porus has decided to meet Alexander but the people refuse to let him get humiliated at the hands of Alexander. The people are willing to sacrifice their lives rather than let Porus suffer humiliation.

videos.title: Signs Of Success
videos.overview: As Porus, Laachi and the rest rejoice on their high notes, Alexander on the other hand in drowning his sorrows in liquor. Barsine tries to stab Alexander but fails miserably.

videos.title: The Successor
videos.overview: Amidst the gloom that the war has brought along with it, Porus learns that Laachi is expecting her first child. Porus and Bamni are ecstatic to learn about the news that comes as a ray of hope amidst the turmoil that the war has left behind.

videos.title: The Plot to Kill The Unborn
videos.overview: Ambhikumar reveals to his mother that he has always harbored feelings for Laachi. Now that Laachi is expecting, Ambhikumar wants the unborn child dead so as to separate Laachi and Porus. Ambhikumar asks his mother to kill the future successor.

videos.title: Another Step To Victory
videos.overview: Roxane goes out from Alexander’s empire, and Alexander’s mother is quite aware of it. Meanwhile Barsine is still being mistreated and her unapologetic attitude is making it worse. Porus and Laachi are happy about their future.

videos.title: Barsine’s Death Sentence
videos.overview: Barsine has been caught for Alexander’s murder plotting. She will now be sentenced to her death. Roxana gets shot by an arrow on her way to Paurav Empire. Porus and his father prepare for a new war.

videos.title: Laachi In Trouble
videos.overview: Ambi-Raj’s mothers tries to poison Laachi’s unborn. Porus finds Roxana’s wounded body, and brings her to the kingdom. Alexander gets furious once he finds Roxana missing.

videos.title: The Magadha Empire
videos.overview: Chanakya and King Bamini seek help from the Dhananand, one of the heads of Magadha Empire. This empire has more spies than soldiers, and they are quite equipped. A helping hand becomes the new move in the game of kings and royals.

videos.title: Dhananand’s Decision
videos.overview: When Chanakya and King Bamini enters the Magadha Empire, to delegate a negotiation with King Dhananand, it’s a tough call. To help or not to help, King Dhananand is stuck on his call. Meanwhile at Paurav Empire Roxane wakes up.

videos.title: The End Is Near
videos.overview: Dhananand has captured Bamini and Chanakya, meanwhile at Paurav Empire Roxane pleads to Porus to let Alexander live and end the war. Ambi-Raj and his mother devise a new plan.

videos.title: The Failed Attempt
videos.overview: Roxane attempts to kill Porus. Her wish to win over Alexander fails as she faces the wrath of Alexander after her return. Meanwhile, Porus intends to save his father and Chanakya.

videos.title: The Negotiation
videos.overview: This time Porus himself and his brother arrive at the Magadha Empire. King Dhana Nanda is not happy with this. While Porus has brought produce and resources to please him, but things aren’t working on his favour.

videos.title: A Tough Choice
videos.overview: Porus arrives at the Magadha Empire and is greeted by King Dhana Nanda. What Porus doesn't know is that Bamni and Chanakya are knocking on death's door. Dhana Nanda presents the scene, where Bamni and Chanakya's lives hang in the balance, to Porus.

videos.title: Abducted
videos.overview: Ambhikumar abducts Laachi when she refuses to leave Porus. Alka tries to stop Ambhikumar but in vain. As a last resort, Alka picks up the bow and arrow and aims at her son.

videos.title: The New Ally
videos.overview: Alka sacrifices her life in an attempt to stop Ambhikumar. Meanwhile, Porus wrestles Dhana Nanda and succeeds in winning his trust. Thus, Porus gets a new ally. Ambhikumar attempts to leave with Laachi but is stopped by Arunayak.

videos.title: The Defenders
videos.overview: Porus feels that in his absence, Alexander might attempt to invade the land. Chanakya has already made sure the Dassiu are defending against the forces of Alexander upon arrival.

videos.title: The Dawn of the Great War
videos.overview: Porus learns that Ambhikumar has abducted Laachi. Bamni arrives with his forces to stop Alexander's march. Before Bamni and Porus' arrival, Alexander brings an end to Arunayak, who dies defending his motherland.

videos.title: The Duel of the Kings
videos.overview: Porus and Alexander face off against each other and go head to head. Laachi sustains injuries while defending her motherland.

videos.title: Alexander Beckons Seleucus
videos.overview: Alexander informs his men to call Seleucus as he wants his General by his side ahead of the war with Porus. Meanwhile, Porus and Laachi lay rest to the men who have sacrificed their lives for their motherland.

videos.title: Dhananand Meets Alexander
videos.overview: Porus sees Dhananand's army marching towards him but, Dhananand hasn't arrived with his army. Dhananand meets Alexander instead and informs him that he is fighting beside Porus.

videos.title: Unity is Strength
videos.overview: Celebrations begin at Pauravrastra and the neighboring kings take part in the extravaganza. Dhananand's presence creates revolt among the kings but Porus makes sure the kings stand united in these testing times.

videos.title: The Game Changer
videos.overview: Porus and Dhananad’s meeting isn’t going so well, and Porus is left at in an undesirable position. Either he has to put his army or his people at stake. Alexander’s fury to conquer Paurav Empire is slowly turning to a selfish pleasure.

videos.title: Seeds of Treason
videos.overview: Alexander crosses the river and breaches Porus' territory. The news of the arrival of Alexander's army reaches Bamni and he decides to help Porus. When Dhananad is asked to stay back, the ruler Magadh asks for his forces to march North.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: Porus has pinned his hopes on Dhananand but ultimately it is the ruler of Magadh who disappoints Porus. Dhananand refuses to fight for Porus and backs out of the alliance.

videos.title: The End Is Near
videos.overview: Porus’s brother gets to face Alexander and his army all alone, resulting to his death. Now it’s just a matter of time. While Porus tries his best to stop this massacre, its way too late

videos.title: The Last Battle
videos.overview: This fight seems like the last one, when Porus is faced with Alexander's great army. Porus with all his might fights his way through an takes revenge for his brother's death.

videos.title: The Epilogue
videos.overview: The battle field has seen it all, the blood of so many armies and the rivalry of so many kings and queens. It's time that Porus needs a morale boost. The end is near, Alexander fights his last battle, and the winner will take it all.

videos.title: The Ultimate Stride
videos.overview: While Alexander's army refuses to support him any further, the war is still not over. Bamini and Porus try their last chance by using wild elephants to their advantage, but advantage becomes a death cause pretty fast, as the poor animals suffer a cruel death. In the end, Bamini gets brutally stabbed. What will happen next?

videos.title: The War Is Almost Over
videos.overview: The enemies at the door. Alexander comes knocking at Paurav empire. It's a fight or flight situation, the end is near and no one knows what will happen next.

videos.title: The Duel of the Immortals
videos.overview: The walls are breached by the Macedonian army. What lies ahead is the clash of the immortals: Alexander and Porus. The two kings go one on one in an epic battle. Porus' will of steel pierces through Alexander's stern quest to conquer Pauravrastra. Alexander finally gives up and decides to embrace peace and march towards Macedonia.

videos.title: The Epic Will Continue
videos.overview: Porus and Alexander end their animosity on good terms. While Alexander leaves India, Porus continues his happy life, but the end is unfortunate for both. Alexander dies off a fatal disease and both Porus and Laachi gets murdered, their newborn gets a chance to survive. This marks the end of a new beginning.
